# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 8 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 1QH (Cave 1), Col. 8 | **Condition:** Better preserved

---

**8:1** They extend their roots to the watercourse; its trunk lies open to the living water.

**8:2** And it becomes a perpetual source. And on the shoots of its foliage all the beasts of the forest feed.

**8:3** Its stock is trampled by all who pass along the way, and its boughs by every bird.

**8:4** And all the trees by the water tower above it, for in their planting they grow tall.

**8:5** But they do not send their root down to the watercourse.

**8:6** And the shoot that brings forth the holy seed for the planting of truth is hidden and held in no esteem.

**8:7** And the mystery of its seal remains unknown, yet You, O God, have enclosed its fruit.

**8:8** By the mystery of valiant warriors and spirits of holiness and the whirling flame of fire.

**8:9** And none [...] shall come to the fountain of life, nor shall he drink with the everlasting trees.

**8:10** The holy waters he shall not touch, nor bear his fruit with the planting of the clouds.

**8:11** For he sees but fails to recognize, and he ponders but cannot believe in the fountain of life.

**8:12** And I [...] become prey for the torrents. But the fruitful planting shall put forth its branches toward the [...].

**8:13** And the shoot of the everlasting planting over all the [...] shall take root.

**8:14** And it shall cover the whole earth with its shade, and its [...] to the clouds.

**8:15** And its roots to the abyss. And all the rivers of Eden [...] shall water the branches.

**8:16** And it shall become [...] a forest of great trees, and the shoot of its planting extends over the whole world.

**8:17** Without boundary and beyond all [...] to Sheol. And the fountain of light shall become an everlasting wellspring.

**8:18** That does not fail. In its gleaming sparks all the children of [...] shall be kindled.

**8:19** And it shall become a consuming fire upon all the men of guilt unto destruction.

**8:20** And those who joined my witness have allowed themselves to be swayed by the interpreters of error.

**8:21** For the wicked have conspired against me, to replace Your Law which You inscribed upon my heart.

**8:22** With flattery toward Your people. And they keep from the thirsty the draught of knowledge.

**8:23** And for their thirst they give them vinegar to drink, to gaze upon their delusion.

**8:24** To grow frenzied at their feasts and to be ensnared in their nets.

**8:25** But You, O God, despise every design of Belial, and it is Your purpose that shall stand.

**8:26** And the intent of Your heart that endures forever.

**8:27** And they — the dissemblers — they devise the stratagems of Belial, and they seek You with a divided heart.

**8:28** And they have no foundation in Your truth. A root that yields poison and wormwood grows in their thoughts.

**8:29** And in the obstinacy of their heart they look about and seek You among idols.

**8:30** And the stumbling-block of their guilt they set before their face.

**8:31** And they come to inquire of You from the mouth of lying prophets, beguiled by error.

**8:32** And then with stammering speech and an alien tongue they speak [...] to Your people.

**8:33** To make all their deeds foolish through deception. For they have not chosen [...] Your [...]

**8:34** And they have not heeded Your word, for they said of the vision of knowledge: It is not reliable.

**8:35** And of the way of Your heart: This is not it.

**8:36** But You, O God, will answer them, to judge them by Your might according to their idols.

**8:37** And according to the abundance of their transgressions, that they may be caught in their own designs — they who have turned from Your covenant.

---

*LOGOS notes: Column 8 continues the botanical imagery from Column 7 before shifting into anti-opponent polemic. The "shoot of the holy seed" (8:6) recalls Isaiah 6:13 LXX. The light-becoming-fire motif (8:17-19) is a dual-edged image. The resumed polemic (8:20-37) essentially repeats Column 3's material.*
